name: Bouteloua

project_scope.note: B002 establishes a four-species Bouteloua comparison set using sideoats grama as the canonical anchor.

shared_traits: inflorescences built from short unilateral spicate branches/racemes
spikelets arranged mainly along one side of each branch
narrow linear leaf blades typical of Chloridoideae grasses
priority: whether branches are spaced down a long axis or clustered near the top
male versus female inflorescence differences in buffalograss
study_strategy.warning: Do not try to identify these four from leaf color or overall 'grassiness.' Start with inflorescence architecture and growth form.

quick_key.if: many short oat-like racemes spaced down one side of a long central axis
creeping stoloniferous sod; male and female inflorescences strongly different, with female clusters low and bur-like
about 5–9 very short fuzzy/awned branches clustered near the top

fast_fill_note: FAST-FILL status: B. curtipendula 4; B. dactyloides 3; B. gracilis 3; B. hirsuta 3; B. trifida 2; B. rigidiseta 1; B. pectinata 0. Remaining gaps are source-limited presentation gaps, not scientific uncertainty. Do not substitute older varietal imagery for current B. pectinata without exact-concept verification.
